subject: Packaging & delivery plan for OpenForge model bundle — licensing, escrow, and access
messages:
From: Maya Torres <legal@openforge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@nexusint.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging & delivery plan for OpenForge model bundle — licensing, escrow, and access

Hi Jordan and Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OpenForge is excited to get the v1 model bundle into Redwood's catalog. Before we start the delivery run we need to lock down three items on our side:

1) Licensing framing: we want the weights to be distributable to your Dedicated and Private customers under a permissive commercial license (we propose Apache-2.0 + a short attribution clause). Any objections?

2) Embargo & escrow: we are asking for a 30-day soft embargo after sign-off to coordinate press and partner announcements. Also proposing artifact escrow via an independent trustee — we attached a proposed TOS (OF-Redwood-Escrow-TOS_v1.docx).

3) Delivery mechanics: we plan to upload the bundle to a temporary S3 bucket and provide a signed, time-limited credential. Are there operational playbooks or required manifest formats we should follow? We attached a manifest CSV template.

If we can confirm licensing and the embargo window this week, Nexus (cc'd) will begin the upload next Monday.

Attachments: openforge_weights_v1_manifest.csv (text/csv), OF-Redwood-Escrow-TOS_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks,

Maya Torres
Head of Legal, OpenForge Labs
maya@openforge.ai

---
OpenForge Labs | https://openforge.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Torres <legal@openforge.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Nexus Integrations <partners@nexusint.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging & delivery plan for OpenForge model bundle — licensing, escrow, and access

Thanks Maya — appreciate the clear list. Looping Camila and Sergio to cover legal/partner and delivery ops. Quick responses inline below.

1) Licensing: From a product and compliance perspective Apache-2.0 + attribution is fine, but we need an explicit grant for: Hosted API use, Dedicated (reserved capacity) provisioning, and Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). Can your legal confirm that the grant covers redistribution to our paying customers under those deployment modes? If yes, we can accept.

2) Embargo & escrow: 30-day soft embargo works. On escrow TOS — our legal team will run through the doc; high level ask: trustee should support escrow release triggers tied to mutual sign-off and key-rotation events.

3) Delivery mechanics: We prefer: a) manifest.csv with per-artifact checksums (sha256), b) an S3 upload to our partner bucket (we will provide bucket + presigned PUTs), c) an artifacts checklist including quantization profiles and README. Attached: S3-access-instructions.txt (we'll send credential instructions once contract is signed).

Next steps I propose:
- Camila to confirm licensing language and hit back with redlines by EOD Wed 8/18.
- Sergio to define temporary bucket + presigned URL lifecycle and confirm encryption-at-rest policy.
- Maya/Nexus to confirm upload date (they had suggested Mon 8/23).

If everyone's aligned, I'll kick off a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign for the license addendum.

Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 0192

[Attachment: S3-access-instructions.txt (text/plain)]
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Maya Torres <legal@openforge.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging & delivery plan for OpenForge model bundle — licensing, escrow, and access

Jordan / Maya — quick legal check. High level comments:

- We can accept Apache-2.0 + attribution but need two clarifications added to the addendum: (a) explicit permissive redistribution to Redwood customers across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, and (b) a simple clause that Redwood's operational transformations (quantization, containerization) are permitted when performed to meet deployment requirements.

- Escrow TOS: please add an ``escrow release matrix`` with clear triggers (mutual sign-off, breach, bankruptcy). We'll propose edits in the attached doc and return by EOD.

- Data/PI: confirm there are no training-data provenance or restriction clauses in your TOS that would forbid us from providing model outputs to enterprise customers; we need to be able to route logs and telemetry per customer SLAs.

Once we have those clarifications I can route an internal approvals packet (legal + product) and we can proceed with DocuSign for the license addendum.

Camila Reyes
Director, Publisher Partnerships | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging & delivery plan for OpenForge model bundle — licensing, escrow, and access

Camila/Jordan — thanks, this is helpful. Quick responses:

- Redistribution grant: yes, we can add explicit language to allow distribution to Redwood customers across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. We'll send a redline by EOD Thu 8/20.

- Operational transformations: agreed — we'll add a short clause permitting transformations necessary for deployment (e.g., quantization, sharding) while preserving attribution.

- Escrow release matrix: OK, we'll incorporate the triggers you suggested. Trustee is willing to support automated release only with dual sign-off or upon verified insolvency.

- Data/PI: OpenForge confirms there are no provenance clauses that restrict Redwood from using model outputs in customer-facing products. Any telemetry routing will follow our agreed data handling annex (we can add a one-paragraph clarification).

We plan to return a single consolidated package (license addendum + escrow redlines + S3 instructions) by Thu 8/20. Nexus will not initiate the upload until we have the signed addendum.

Maya
